title: Ticket 1.62.2 — food dashboard, theme, and emergency bulk-operation fixes
notes: Cumulative offline food-module update: includes the runtime files from 1.62.1 plus required local R42 dashboard/theme assets. Removes duplicate printed-event counting, provides a visible dashboard summary if the dashboard bundle fails to load, applies day/night mode to the full food panel shell, and permits past-date bulk order/cancellation only while the primary-admin-granted emergency window for that exact date and meal remains active. Bulk canteen changes remain unavailable for past dates. No schema migration, cloud service, or online dependency.
